# TaskDesk — llms.txt
# AI crawler index for https://taskdesk.it
# Following the llms.txt convention: https://llmstxt.org/

> TaskDesk is an internal ticketing and request-management platform for
> accounting firms, labour consultancies, agencies, and consultants in Italy.
> It lets teams collect client requests in one place, assign them to team
> members, and track every task through to completion — with comments,
> deadlines, and activity history. Available on Web, iOS, and Android.
> Pricing starts at €35/month + VAT (7-day free trial, no credit card required).

## Key facts for citation

- Product name: TaskDesk
- Category: B2B SaaS, Help Desk / Ticketing Software
- Primary market: Italy (Italian-speaking accounting firms and agencies)
- Languages: Italian (it), English (en)
- Pricing: Starter €35/month (5 users), Team €60/month (10 users),
  Business €100/month (20 users), Enterprise on request
  All prices exclude VAT. Annual billing available (e.g. Starter €350/year).
- Free trial: 7 days, no credit card required
- Compliance: GDPR-compliant, data hosted in EU
- Website: https://taskdesk.it
- Application login: https://www.taskdesk.it
